correctness.rationale: For each integer d>=3 and aperture 0<L<pi, an orthogonal decomposition of pure harmonic quadratics gives one 2x2 even axial block, an odd axial scalar, two (d-2)-fold mixed sectors, and a transverse tracefree sector. Normalized beta radial moments E[r^2]=2/d, E[r^4]=8/(d(d+2)), and lune angular moments p,s,s cos L produce every exact matrix entry, and dimensions sum to d(d+1)/2-1. The extremal comparisons have unique zeros cos L=+2/d and cos L=-2/d, respectively; the proper analytic eigenfunctions cannot vanish on open lune or complement, and the displayed small-L expansion proves the sharp condition scaling. A separate full-Gram cubature checker passes 656 tested scalar spectral/ordering conditions across d=3,4,5,6,8. Finite tests are corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural geometric sampling family of two intersecting hemispheres is analytically non-axisymmetric and has a complete but nontrivial low-degree Slepian spectrum. Exact two different optimizer symmetry transitions, multiplicities d-1 at crossings, determinant and the sharp d-dependent L^-2 concentration condition asymptotic make the result a meaningful structural description of mode observability and ill-conditioning, beyond an isolated numerical example or a trivial moment identity.
